literal_meaning: ঘড়ি ধরে (clock holding or by the clock)
figurative_meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট সময়ে; সময়ের এতটুকু ব্যতিক্রম না করে
figurative_meaning_en: At the specified time; without the slightest deviation from the schedule
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় ঘড়ি ধরে উত্তর লিখতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He arrives at the office by the clock every day.
You need to write answers by the clock during the exam.
note: This idiom reflects the influence of modern timekeeping in Bengali society.
